title: Companion current-view sharing
description: Copies a real run URL from Android into the mounted Command Center run, opens the native share sheet and starts the existing foreground Voice recorder without sending.

proofTargets.claim: The actual Android clipboard URL opens the same run and timeline in authenticated Command Center web.
The native Android share sheet receives the identical copied run URL.
Copying and sharing execute no terminal or runner command.
Long press reaches the existing worker recorder with the source run context.
The source run context and reviewed instruction reach only the exact owned worker after explicit Send.
Menu Voice reaches the existing recorder with the same context and a discarded draft causes no command.

begin.intent: Record clean command counters before sharing.

wait-quick-actions.intent: Attach to the already running Companion.

open-run.intent: Navigate normally to the prepared target run.

wait-run.intent: Confirm the actual target run is visible.

open-menu.intent: Open quick actions without starting voice.

menu-image.intent: Let the operator check the current-view options in their visible order.

open-web.intent: Open that exact native clipboard URL in Command Center.

web-identity.intent: Verify the mounted web run and timeline match the clipboard.

share.intent: Share the same current run link through Android.

share-sheet.intent: Retain the identical URL in the real native share sheet.

dismiss-share.intent: Return from the native share sheet.

no-commands.intent: Prove sharing executed no terminal or runner command.

long-press-voice.intent: Start foreground Voice directly from the run.

return-original-run.intent: Leave the original run visible after the two voice gestures.

original-run-visible.intent: The operator is back on the same run after discarding the draft.
